    Settings

    Controls

    Click a key to change it, then press the new key (Esc cancels, Backspace clears). Each action can have two keys.

    Standing still, a dash always goes where you're aiming. Applies to keyboard and controller.

    Controller

    No controller found. Plug one in (Xbox or PlayStation style) and press any button.

    Left stick moveRight stick aimRight trigger draw and fireA / Cross or left trigger dash LB / RB abilities Q and EStart menuX, Y, B pick upgrade 1, 2, 3 Aim assist: built in for controllers, one strength for everyone. Near an enemy your aim slows down and is drawn most of the way toward a spot just ahead of them, in the direction they're moving. You still finish the aim yourself, and it never locks on. The mouse is never assisted Menus: D-pad or left stick to move, A to select, B to go back. On a list, left and right change it
    Achievements

    Challenges

    Each achievement has five tiers, from Bronze to Diamond, and shows how rare your tier is among players. They're earned in ranked games and in custom games without bots. Everyone in your games sees the title you pick next to your name.
